analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Broadly
analysis.quote: When you use our Service, we may share information about you with our affiliates, businesses and advertisers on Yelp, content and data partners, service providers, and third-party platforms.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Precise Location
analysis.quote: You may choose to allow Yelp to collect and store certain sensitive personal information about you (e.g., precise geolocation).

analysis.headline: Trains AI on Your Content
analysis.quote: For example, we may use such AI Technologies to analyze and process your contributions and interactions... develop new products and features; train or fine-tune AI models.

analysis.headline: Tracks You Across Devices
analysis.quote: The information that we collect and store through those different devices and platforms may be cross-referenced and combined, and your contributions will typically be similarly visible and accessible through all Yelp platforms.

analysis.headline: Monitors Your Conversations
analysis.quote: We may monitor or track your actions when you send or receive messages using the Service (e.g., direct messages, quote requests sent to businesses, AI chatbot communications, and similar features) , such as whether you opened, deleted, or forwarded such messages, and share that information with other parties to your messages.

analysis.headline: Third Parties Track You
analysis.quote: While we control the Cookies that are integrated into our Service, we do not control Cookies that are set on third-party platforms or sites, even where those cookies track your activity across our Service and third-party platforms or sites.

analysis.headline: Your Public Content Republished
analysis.quote: We may allow third-party partners to use certain content on Yelp, such as by reproducing, adapting, distributing, performing and displaying, some of the publicly available content on the Service, such as your photos, reviews, and other information.

analysis.headline: Cannot Delete Business Page
analysis.quote: Please note that businesses cannot remove their business pages, ratings, or reviews by closing their accounts.

analysis.headline: Engages in Targeted Advertising
analysis.quote: Yelp may engage in “targeted advertising” as that term is defined by applicable law. Residents of certain states have the right to opt-out of targeted behavioral advertising, which you can do here.
